headlines.title: EIA Sees 600,000 Bpd of Middle East Oil Still Offline by End-2027
headlines.summary: The longer-than-expected closure of the Strait of Hormuz means that some part of the oil production in the Middle East will remain shut in through the end of next year, the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) said in its latest Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO) this week.
